mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patent WHERE applicant_enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patent WHERE applicant_enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND maintenance_years >= 5 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, patent_number, patent_name, patent_type, applicant, applicant_enterprise_id, ipc_main, application_date, legal_status, maintenance_years, data_source, region_id, created_at, updated_at FROM patent WHERE applicant_enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY maintenance_years DESC, application_date DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(ipc_main, '未分类') AS tech_field, COUNT(*) AS patent_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN maintenance_years >= 5 THEN 1 END) AS high_value_count, ROUND(AVG(maintenance_years), 2) AS avg_maintenance_years FROM patent WHERE applicant_enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ipc_main ORDER BY patent_count DESC

SELECT e.id AS enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, e.unified_code AS unified_code, e.legal_representative AS legal_representative, e.registered_address AS registered_address, e.region_id AS region_id, e.is_local AS is_local, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patent_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.maintenance_years >= 5 THEN p.id END) AS high_value_count FROM enterprise e INNER JOIN patent p ON e.id = p.applicant_enterprise_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN patent_node pn ON p.id = pn.patent_id WHERE pn.node_id = #{nodeId} AND e.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.unified_code, e.legal_representative, e.registered_address, e.region_id, e.is_local ORDER BY patent_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
